Extrude a curve or surface in both sides along a vector

**Panel:** Comma → Surface · **Nickname:** `ExtrBS`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to extrude |
| Direction | `D` | Vector | Item | `Vector3d.Zero` | Extrude direction. If none is provided, used the normal vector of input curve |
| Length | `L` | Number | Item | `1000.00` | Extrude length |
| Both Sides | `B` | Integer | Item | `2` | Extrusion type<br>Options: One side; Both sides, same length; Both sides, length/2 |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Extrusion | `E` | Brep | Item | Extrusion result |
